answer: A Weekly community check-in streak over one year verified by moderator confirmations makes identity a record of showing up: every week the applicant signs in, the moderator confirmations go on the public record, and one missed week resets the streak to zero, so the network trusts the account that was there every week, not the one that appeared yesterday. A vertex out of place triggers the check: the claim is frozen until the streak clears. From the atlas to the lotus, the same rule holds: no presence, no trust, no exception.
